captions.facebook:
“And if they could survive, so can I.”

Reading other people’s stories is what showed me that even though I was “different” because of the trauma, there were other people out there with similar stories and feelings. That’s what I want this to be for anyone who comes across it when life feels like too much.

From His Unlived Life, on Not Plain. Read it here:
https://sarahnotplain.substack.com/p/his-unlived-life
